description: Sample news articles for testing sentiment analysis

articles.title: Apple Reports Record Q4 Earnings, Beats Analyst Expectations
articles.summary: Apple Inc. reported better-than-expected quarterly results with iPhone sales surging and strong growth in services revenue. The company's earnings per share came in at $1.64, beating Wall Street estimates of $1.60.

articles.title: Apple's New AI Features Drive Strong iPhone 15 Demand
articles.summary: The integration of advanced AI capabilities in iPhone 15 has led to unprecedented demand, with pre-orders exceeding expectations. Analysts predict this could be Apple's strongest product cycle in years.

articles.title: Supply Chain Concerns May Impact Apple's Holiday Quarter
articles.summary: Industry sources report potential supply chain disruptions that could affect Apple's ability to meet holiday demand. Component shortages in Asia may lead to production delays.

articles.title: Apple Services Revenue Reaches All-Time High
articles.summary: Apple's services division, including App Store, Apple Music, and iCloud, generated record revenue this quarter. The high-margin services business continues to be a major growth driver.

articles.title: Regulatory Scrutiny Increases for Apple's App Store Policies
articles.summary: European regulators are intensifying their investigation into Apple's App Store practices, potentially leading to significant fines and mandatory policy changes. This adds to ongoing antitrust concerns.

articles.title: Apple Vision Pro Pre-Orders Exceed Expectations in Key Markets
articles.summary: Apple's mixed reality headset is seeing strong initial demand in major markets, with pre-orders selling out quickly. Industry analysts view this as validation of Apple's spatial computing vision.

articles.title: Market Volatility Impacts Tech Stocks, Apple Included
articles.summary: Broader market concerns about interest rates and economic uncertainty have led to increased volatility in tech stocks. Apple shares have experienced fluctuations alongside the overall sector.

articles.title: Apple Expands Manufacturing Operations in India
articles.summary: Apple is significantly expanding its production capacity in India as part of its supply chain diversification strategy. The move is expected to reduce dependency on China and improve operational resilience.

articles.title: Apple Announces Sustainability Initiative, Commits to Carbon Neutrality
articles.summary: Apple unveiled ambitious plans to achieve complete carbon neutrality across its entire supply chain and product lifecycle by 2030. The initiative includes significant investments in renewable energy.

articles.title: Analysts Raise Apple Price Targets Following Strong Performance
articles.summary: Multiple Wall Street analysts have raised their price targets for Apple stock, citing strong fundamentals, growing services revenue, and positive momentum in iPhone sales. Average target now stands at $220.
